events.label: ADP Private Payrolls (Aug 5, 8:15 AM ET) — NFP warm-up; consensus ~100K
events.note: Updated Aug 5 morning: ADP is the private-sector payroll estimate ahead of Friday BLS NFP (consensus +91K, prior 147K). September hike at ~54% (Kalshi), down from 82.4% July 31. June ADP was 98K; weekly data through early July showed slowing (~16,500/week). Below 80K: September approaches 45%, 30Y has path toward 5.00%. Above 150K: September rebounds toward 60-65%, narrowing the gap to the 70% trigger. ISM Services prices-paid also Wednesday at 10:00 AM ET — if services follows manufacturing's 71.1%, rate pressure rises regardless of ADP.

events.label: US-Iran Hormuz interim deal announcement (targeted today) — 60-day ceasefire via Oman
events.note: Bessent said deal possible 'today or tomorrow'; Iranian leadership completed approval process August 5. 60-day interim arrangement via Oman allowing safe inbound/outbound shipping. WTI already at $75.40 (−5.7% Tuesday) — deal priced meaningfully but not fully. Formal signing opens next leg toward $68-70 as Persian Gulf supply restores. Airlines (fuel cost deflation), consumer discretionary (disposable income), and logistics are the transmission vehicles; energy producers face headwinds until OPEC+ responds. Deal resets at each 60-day extension. Breaking: any IRGC military action restores WTI $82+ in one session.

events.label: July NFP (BLS, 8:30 AM ET) — September hike binary; odds at 54% (Kalshi)
events.note: Updated Aug 4 night: September hike probability fell from 82.4% (July 31) to ~54% (Aug 4 Kalshi) — a 28-point improvement in four sessions driven by oil deflation and cooling JOLTS (June 7.36M vs 7.54M prior). Regime is now 1-of-6 breaches (30Y at 5.20% only). Consensus: +91K (prior 147K). Above 130K: September rebounds toward 70%, re-triggering formal breach; 30Y extends toward 5.28%; AMD/SPCX AH selloffs compound in regular session. Below 80K: September approaches 45-50%, 30Y has path toward 5.00%; 0-of-6 regime becomes medium-term possibility. In 80K-130K range: neutral; 1-of-6 regime holds. FOMC September 15-16.

events.label: July CPI (est.) — Iran oil re-surge and tariff pass-through fully embedded
events.note: Updated Aug 4 night: July CPI embeds the pre-ceasefire Brent average (~$85-91/bbl) from the Iran escalation period; the August 3-4 collapse to $78-79 may not yet appear in the comp. September hike at 54% means the rate market has partially priced in oil deflation, but July CPI carries the backward-looking oil shock. A print above 3.5% makes September near-certain and sends 30Y back toward 5.28%. Below 3.0% opens the formal 30Y clearing path toward 5.00%. Either print resets Jackson Hole framing.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — PLTR 149% + AMD $6.7B data-center are strongest pre-NVDA demand confirmations
events.note: Updated Aug 4 night: PLTR's 149% US commercial growth (Aug 3 AH) and AMD's $6.7B data-center Q2 (+107% YoY, Aug 4 AH) are the most constructive demand confirmations heading into an NVDA quarter this cycle has produced. AMD's AH −8% on a strong beat (from an elevated pre-earnings entry of $518) establishes that the market does not automatically reward AI hardware results at premium valuations. On the Q2 FY27 call watch: (1) Circular financing disclosure — OpenAI $250B backstop still unaddressed; (2) AVGO $128.1B purchase commitment and AMD $6.7B data-center confirm hyperscaler demand is real; (3) AMD MI450 share capture in hyperscaler buildout is the key competitive question; (4) Kimi K3 efficiency headwind unchanged. $216 stop intact.

events.label: Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium (Aug 27–29) — Warsh keynote on September FOMC path
events.note: Updated Aug 4 night: September hike probability is now ~54% (Kalshi), down from 82.4% on July 31. The keynote arrives after NFP (Aug 7) and CPI (Aug 13). At 54%, the framing matters: 'data-dependent, watching oil deflation' keeps September well below 70%; any 'live meeting, inflation concern' language restores the trigger breach. Consequential path: NFP above 130K then CPI above 3.5% then Jackson Hole as a lock-in signal. Inverse: NFP below 80K then CPI below 3.0% then Warsh de-escalates and 30Y retreats toward 5.00%.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs. Early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Context: SPCX Q2 showed $18.37B capex vs $7.81B revenue — capital-intensive build raises the stakes for the lock-up dynamic.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. PLTR's 149% US commercial growth (Aug 3) and AMD's $6.7B data-center (+107%) confirm the enterprise AI adoption that underlies OpenAI's revenue model — constructive for S-1 framing. NVDA circular financing disclosure ($250B OpenAI backstop) remains the unresolved structural question that may surface in S-1 filings.
